steps.note: Merged [1,3] and [2] -> [1,2,3]. Odd length, the middle value 2 is the median.
Merged [1,2] and [3,4] -> [1,2,3,4]. Even length, average the two middle values: (2 + 3) / 2 = 2.5.
The optimized way never merges: binary search finds the cut where left halves hold exactly half the elements, then reads the border values. Final answer for this case: 2.5.
